data.command: Check the system logs for any recent activity

data.text:
Let me check the system logs for you. I'm currently running on Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS, and I've got a bunch of system logs stored in /var/log/. I'm using the systemd journal for logging, so I'll check the journal files for any recent activity.

`sudo journalctl -f -n 100`

This command will show me the last 100 lines of system log output. I'm filtering the output to show the most recent entries, and I'll display the results here.

**Output:**
